name: Plank
accessibilityLabel: Grey mannequin holding a forearm plank with a straight body line and abdominal muscles highlighted.
prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: original square workout exercise illustration.
Input1 is the canonical identity/style REFERENCE ONLY; create the new exercise below.
Keep EXACT SAME adult pale slate-grey mannequin, oval bald head, natural athletic build, realistic proportions, matte material, short charcoal training shorts and charcoal shoes. Match restrained premium 3D rendering, soft upper-left lighting, light cool-grey #F3F5F7 background and subtle contact shadow.
Only specified exposed primary muscle bellies use muted coral #DF685A. Remove reference biceps highlights; do not highlight joints, bones, secondary muscles or through clothing. No glow or veins.
One whole figure and complete specified equipment, near-orthographic low-distortion camera, square 1024x1024, 7–9% margins. Plausible hands, limbs and support contacts. No text, logos, numbers, arrows, panels, duplicates or gym scenery.

Exercise: FOREARM PLANK. Body horizontal face down, elbows directly under shoulders bent90deg, forearms parallel flat on floor with palms down. Legs straight, toes tucked planted, feet hip-width. Straight shoulders-hips-ankles line with neutral pelvis and spine, no sagging and no pike. Head neutral looking floor between forearms. LOW SIDE-front three-quarter camera showing nearer arm/elbow support, far forearm, both toes, whole body and visible front-side abdomen. Highlight only exposed RECTUS ABDOMINIS and visible OBLIQUES on abdomen, no chest/arms/legs. No equipment/mat/barbell.

review.notes: Forearms and toes support full body; elbows roughly under shoulders, straight hip-to-ankle line and neutral head. Abdominal overlay visible on exposed front-side torso, limbs grey.
review.independentNotes: Viewed full image: forearms and toes grounded, elbows below shoulders and trunk/hips aligned; abdominal cue confined to exposed torso.
